title: Transfer valves.
officialText:
Deck-mounted bath/shower transfer valves containing an integral atmospheric vacuum breaker shall conform
to the requirements of ASME A112.18.7.
SECTION PC 425
FLUSHING DEVICES FOR WATER CLOSETS AND
URINALS
